disposition: Retain the audited Russian source and SHA-256 unchanged. Obvious typing slips (stray or missing punctuation, missing spaces, single wrong letters) are read past in the Romanian, as in R001.01; Gospel references are kept exactly as printed even where they are wrong; Tolstoy's French quotation is kept in French. One reading (p. 856, «вражды», possibly for «жажды») could affect meaning and is translated as written pending the print witness. None of these holds the unit out of reviewed status.
